title: Verification result
description: What happened when the pipeline ran one job: verification/results/ID/result.json, next to the job's logs (logs/), the diff of the outputs it produced (changes.diff), and any outputs not applied (outputs/). Read status, summary and attention first; everything else is evidence.

status.description: passed: every step exited as expected. failed: a step did not, which for a verifier usually means it found a problem, or the command was wrong. timeout and out-of-memory: a step was stopped at a limit and gave no verdict; rerun with more (resubmit). error: the pipeline could not run the job (a missing tool, a build failure). cancelled: the runner was stopped.

summary.description: One line: status, steps, time and memory against the estimate, changed outputs, and the verdict lines found in the logs.

attention.description: What a reader should look at, in words: a step that did not pass, a pass with a suspicious log (JBMC with no verdict, an out-of-memory line), an estimate far off, outputs not applied. Empty for a clean pass.

spec.description: The job as it was run.

sourceCommit.description: The commit whose tree was run.

isolation.description: systemd: each step in a scope with hard memory and CPU caps, measured by the cgroup. none: timeouts only, memory measured per process.

usage.description: What the steps used, without the jvmcontract build. The ratios against the estimate are for calibrating the next estimate.

jvmcontract.description: The jvmcontract the job ran with: built from lib/ at the job's commit, cached by the tree id of lib/.

steps.description: Every step, in order. Index 0 is the jvmcontract build, when the job needed one that was not cached.

signal.description: The signal that ended the step's process, if one did.

stoppedFor.description: Why the runner stopped the step: stalled (past its timeout, no CPU and no output for the stall window) or ceiling (still working at the runner's max_timeout). Null when it ended by itself or was cancelled.

overranTimeout.description: The step ran past its timeout while still working and was left to run.

timeoutSeconds.description: The step's timeout: where the runner starts looking for a stall, not a deadline.

cpuThrottledSeconds.description: Time held back by the CPU cap: high means the job wanted more CPUs than it asked for.

oomKills.description: Processes the kernel killed at the step's memory limit.

memoryHighEvents.description: Times the step reached its memory limit.

truncated.description: The log was too long, and the file holds its head and tail. The whole log stays on the runner, at fullLog.

signalCounts.description: How often each kind of verdict line appeared, as tool:kind.

signals.description: The verdict lines themselves (JBMC, TLC, jvmcontract, build.py, cargo test, out of memory), with their line numbers in the log; at most 100.

tail.description: The last 40 lines of the log.

outputs.description: Declared outputs that differ from the job's commit.

changesDiff.description: The file that holds the outputs' changes against the job's commit: changes.diff, a unified diff; or, once collected, changes.diff.gz (that diff gzipped) or changes.stat (a summary of the files it changes) when the diff was over the 1 MiB a commit takes (collected.changesDiff).

workdir.description: The work directory, kept on the runner (for a job that did not pass, by default).

collected.description: Set when the result was collected into the repo. applied: outputs written to the working copy. conflicts: outputs that changed in the working copy since the job's commit, not applied, kept under outputs/. kept: outputs not applied because the job did not pass.

changesDiff.description: Set when changes.diff was over the 1 MiB a commit takes (jj's snapshot.max-new-file-size): its size, the file kept in its place, and how.
